subject: Q3 action items - quick summary?
snippet: Could you send me a one-line summary...
body:
Hi,

Could you send me a one-line summary of the Q3 action items for the deck?

Thanks,
Alex

triage.summary: Alex wants a one-sentence summary of the Q3 action items for a deck.
triage.draft_reply: Hi Alex - Q3 action items: finalize the budget by Friday, kick off the data hiring loop, and send the revised SOW to legal.
